independence_rule: only dec_dt strictly after the cutoff; no pre-cutoff trade can enter

accrual.start: first observed official A-share session strictly after decision_cutoff_inclusive
accrual.enrollment: all production delay5 decisions in the first 60 post-freeze sessions
accrual.close: after the 60th post-freeze session and strict-next-session fill observability

production_rules.raw: anticipate structural onset, decision delay=5, decision regime in [5, 6, 7, 8]
production_rules.gate: signal-day sig_vol_ratio<=0.8, sig_ma_spread_pct>=3.0, sig_ret20>=8.0; above_zg unused
production_rules.st: non-ST on decision date according to required local namechange intervals
production_rules.fill: finite panel open on the strict next market session and gap_pct < limit_pct - 0.3pct
production_rules.mature: 60th common market session from entry is present; no FULL outcome field is read

matching.name: pit_exact_industry_mcap2_conditional_entropy_v1
matching.industry: same frozen annual industry; missing treated industry is unsupported
matching.candidate_pool: all controls with complete frozen causal balance features inside the inclusive exact point-in-time circ_mv caliper
matching.weighting: conditional entropy tilting with one all-scope and one 2024plus-scope coefficient per balance feature; weights normalize to one within each treated trade
matching.forward_transport: no refit: apply frozen feature scales and all+2024plus entropy coefficients to every new treated trade's eligible controls, then normalize within trade
matching.future_exact_mcap: archive one complete daily_basic cross-section on each enrolled decision date before outcome access

outcome_lock.unlock_condition: accrual is closed, next-session fill is observable for every enrolled decision, and every enrolled filled trade has its fixed 60th common session observed
outcome_lock.path_policy: no-open or gap-at-limit control stays cash without replacement; post-entry suspension uses LOCF

inference.success_gate: positive ATT and HAC-Holm<0.05 and stationary-bootstrap-Holm<0.05 and two-way-cluster p<0.05

data_capture.late_backfill_policy: reported separately and excluded from the primary forward sample
